values.fieldLabel: How should a main character purchase equipment for the main character from the Maple Auction?

values.option: Check for the cheapest, clean (non-Spell Trace/Star Force/Normal Potential/Additional Potential enhanced, but can have Additional Stats in blue text), then slowly enhance them with event and Daily Gift items.
Check for the most expensive equipment as they boost the clean damage range for the main character the most.
Check for equipment without following a guideline.

values.fieldLabel: How do you defeat each of Normal Akechi Mitsuhide's three parts?

values.option: Use any other attack skill which causes less total % skill damage for all hits for the initial attack.

values.fieldLabel: If your Magic damage type Maple Union configuration has too many Magician characters who are at least lv250, such that you need to the Maple Union pieces are starting to overlap with each other, what would you carry out?

values.option: Keep the overlapping as it is.
Re-create the Magic damage type Maple Union configuration, starting with the at least lv200 Warrior Maple Union pieces, to eventually resolve the overlapping.
